name: bob-code-consistency-review-scaffold
description: Scaffold for bob code consistency pre-review MVP tooling.

scripts.smoke:validate-output: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js validate-output --package .tmp/review-package --bob-output tests/fixtures/bob-output.valid.yaml
scripts.smoke:triage: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js triage --package .tmp/review-package --bob-output tests/fixtures/bob-output.valid.yaml --out .tmp/human-triage
